limitations: A later daily-profile report confirmed actual renderer 0x0 with noFocus. dsh.6 had not fixed that condition; see validation-0.4.2-dsh.7.json.
Headful test used an inactive Windows desktop and fresh profile; it does not prove every daily-profile/window-manager condition.
Cancelling a read ends the caller wait, not the native Chrome command. New captures remain gated until the original command settles or its attachment detaches.

correction.issue: Both background scenarios actually used --window-size=1280,900. The prior headful no-startup-size claim was false; injected metric responses did not force the renderer itself to 0x0.
